text:
support-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: sudden spike in 504s for /v1/generate on hosted-prod starting ~11:40Z. Error rate ~18% across multiple tenants (AcmeCorp, ByteLayer). Upstream gateway timeouts and retry loops detected.
carol: We just got 6 escalations from Acme support. They report timeouts and duplicate billing retries. Any recent deploys?
alice: I merged a matrix rollout yesterday that routed 5% traffic to 'matrix-router-v2' + a config flag flip for route-by-kernel. Not aware of auth changes.
eng_jaya: Investigating logs. Seeing a pattern: requests routed to v2 are missing X-Auth-Token at the proxy layer -> proxied service returns 401 -> client retries -> gateway eventually times out returning 504. Suspect header normalization + new routing path.
sre_tom: Can repro locally against canary. Quick curl:```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Model-Variant: matrix-v2" \\n  "https://hosted.redwood.example/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
```
eng_jaya: Logs from proxy (canary):```
[2026-03-16T11:41:03Z] WARN incoming headers: {authorization: "Bearer ...", x-model-variant: "matrix-v2"} 
[2026-03-16T11:41:03Z] ERROR upstream auth: missing header X-Auth-Token -> dropping
[2026-03-16T11:41:04Z] INFO retry attempt 1
[2026-03-16T11:41:10Z] ERROR upstream timeout
```
carol: Wait, proxy log shows 'authorization' lowercased and 'x-model-variant' lowercased. Our auth service expects 'X-Auth-Token' header (case sensitive) — did the new router rewrite headers?
alice: The canary included an env var: HEADER_NORMALIZATION=enabled to standardize headers for kernel routing. That was intended for internal use but might have interfered with legacy auth.
bob: Okay safety steps: (1) pause canary routing, (2) roll traffic back to stable, (3) flip HEADER_NORMALIZATION off on canary. I'll coordinate.
infra-bot: Executing rollback: routing-policy 'matrix-rollout' scale from 5% -> 0% for hosted-prod. Command issued: `controller route update matrix-rollout --traffic 0`
sre_tom: Rolling back k8s deployment for matrix-router-v2 on cluster prod-canary: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/matrix-router-v2 -n hosted-prod`
infra-bot: Done. Traffic now at 0%. Monitoring endpoints for 15m.
support-bot: 504 rate dropped to 1.9% within 3 minutes. Alerts returning to normal threshold.
carol: Notifying impacted customers and issuing credits for duplicate billing incidents. Draft message in #support-drafts.
dave: Quick postmortem notes: root cause seems to be combined effect of header normalization + a routing change that sent auth-proxied traffic through a path that didn't translate the legacy X-Auth-Token header. That caused auth failures, client retries, and eventual gateway timeouts.
alice: Action items: 1) Add routing integration test that validates auth headers preserved end-to-end; 2) Make header handling explicit (no silent normalization); 3) Add a canary gating test for auth success before traffic shift; 4) Run a sweep for other env flags that may affect headers. I'll open PRs.
eng_jaya: I'll add an automated smoke that sends a signed request and asserts 200 within 500ms against canary before route change.
bob: Good. Also add a safeguard: when route change interacts with header flags, block auto-advance.
carol: All good for now. I'll keep customers updated and collect timelines for the postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
